name: BITEZ - D8 + D9 + THCP 2000MG Gummies - Sour Watermelon Lemonade
description:
Level up your ritual with Double-Stacked Sour Watermelon Lemonade gummies. Each 2-count bag delivers a massive 1,000mg per gummy, precision-blended with Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP for an uncompromising entourage effect. These dual-layer edibles fuse mouth-puckering sour watermelon with a bright, zesty lemonade finish for a refreshing high-potency experience. Engineered for seasoned enthusiasts who demand peak intensity and complex flavor—grab this heavy-hitter today!

Sour Watermelon Lemonade layers juicy Watermelon with refreshing Lemonade flavor, packing 2,000mg per bag and 1,000mg per gummy. Each gummy features a potent blend of THCP, Delta-9, and Delta-8 for a stacked BITEZ experience.
